snippet.title: TurretGirls - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Lock, load, and hold the line! Earth’s last defense is a girl, a turret, and a whole lotta attitude. TurretGirls Blasts onto Steam This Summer! Demo Available Now!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3029750/TurretGirls/

About TurretGirls

Grody extraterrestrials are pouring through a space-time rift, and only one girl and her turret stand in their way! Lock, load, and blast them to oblivion, because if she doesn’t survive today, there’s no ‘omurice’ tomorrow! Earth depends on her!

TURRET GIRLS: SIGN UP AND START BLASTING!
Mysterious alien invaders are swarming through unstable wormholes, threatening our great planet for reasons beyond human understanding! But do we sit back and wait? HELL NO! We FIGHT!

Join Girl, a member of the Planetary Alien Neutralization & Tactical Strike Unit (P.A.N.T.S.U.), on the frontlines of Earth's survival! Her mission? Defend the power generator, the beating heart of humanity’s last, greatest hope: THE SUPERWEAPON!

She stands alone atop her turret, the last line of defense against the alien horde. No backup. No retreat. Just firepower, grit, and the promise of a well-earned plate of 'omurice' awaiting her return.

- Upgrade your turret!
- Build frontline generators!
- Charge the superweapon!
- Blast alien scum back to whatever hell they crawled out of!

STATE-OF-THE-ART RAIL-TURRET SYSTEM
Strap in, lock on, and blast away! Our on-rails turret platform provides unparalleled versatility and top-tier alien-annihilating firepower, so even the greenest recruit can rack up confirmed kills!

UPGRADABLE ARMAMENTS & EQUIPMENT
The battlefield is always changing, and so are you! Every mission completed, every alien fried means more resources to upgrade your defenses, power generation, and devastating firepower! Perform well, and you’ll earn the best tech humanity has to offer!

TACTICAL QUICK-TEAR UNIFORM
Your uniform is battle-tested, stress-resistant, and strategically disposable! Under extreme conditions, it will self-disintegrate to ensure maximum survivability and maneuverability. Who needs dignity when you can have victory?

PERFORMANCE-BASED REQUISITIONS
Earn your stripes! High-ranking troopers are rewarded with fresh underwear, elite accessories, and upgraded turret systems! Fight harder, score higher, and earn the best gear, because winners don’t wear rags!

#TurretGirls
